# The edit document (`edit.json`): every field

<!-- Generated by `viraleditor schema --markdown` from viraleditor/src/edit/schema.ts, presets.ts and src/cli/notes.ts. Do not edit: a test fails when this file differs from what the command prints. -->

How to use the editor: [the guide](../guide/viraleditor.md). This file is the full list; `viraleditor schema --json` gives the same as data.

## How to read it

- A path names a field: `shots[].from` is the field "from" of every entry of the list "shots"; `media.<key>` is the entry of "media" under a key you choose. A form of a field that has several is written `{kind}`: `Motion{push-in}.to` is the field "to" of a motion whose "kind" is "push-in".
- A frame is a whole number on the timeline of the whole video, never relative to a shot: frame 0 is the first, and 30 frames are one second. "at" is the first frame of a thing, "for" the number of frames it lasts.
- A box is written as its four edges in percent of the canvas: left and right of its width, top and bottom of its height. Right and bottom are edges, not sizes.
- A name is 1 to 32 characters: a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits or "-". A colour is "#rgb", "#rrggbb" or "#rrggbbaa". A file name is "assets/" and a name of letters, digits, ".", "_" and "-".
- A field that is not listed is an error, not ignored. "required" in the Default column: the field must be there. "none": the field may be left out, and nothing takes its place.

## The document

The fields of edit.json itself. Each part has its own table below.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | 1 | required | The version of this format. Always 1. |
| `language` | language tag | required | The language of the copy, as a tag such as "en" or "tr": it decides upper-casing and line breaking. |
| `canvas` | object | required | The size and the rate of the video. |
| `frames` | whole number 1 … 1800 | required | The length of the video in frames. It must equal the end of the last shot ("at" + "for"). |
| `background` | colour | "#000000" | The colour behind everything, where no picture covers the canvas. Opaque (no alpha). |
| `safe` | one of "tiktok", "reels", "both", "none" | "both" | Which platform's safe area the texts, captions and cards must stay inside (see Safe areas). "none" switches the check off. |
| `media` | one object per key (at most 300) | required | Every file the video uses, under a key the other fields refer to. |
| `styles` | one object per key (at most 50) | none | Text styles of your own. A key that is a preset name (hook, label, tag, caption) replaces that preset; a text in it then comes and goes like a style of your own (fade 6 in and out, no stagger), not like the preset. |
| `shots` | list of objects (at least 1, at most 120) | required | The pictures of the video, in time order. They tile it: each starts on the frame the one before it ends. |
| `texts` | list of objects (at most 200) | none | Lines of text over the picture: hooks, labels, tags. |
| `captions` | object | none | The spoken words shown word by word, in groups, with the word being spoken marked. |
| `cards` | list of objects (at most 100) | none | Pictures over the footage: a product photo, a screenshot. |
| `audio` | object | none | The music, sound effects and the loudness of the mix. The own sound of a clip is switched on at its shot ("sound"). |

## `canvas`

The size and the rate of the video.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `canvas.width` | one of 720, 1080 | required | Pixels across. 720 goes with 1280, 1080 with 1920. |
| `canvas.height` | one of 1280, 1920 | required | Pixels down. |
| `canvas.fps` | 30 | required | Frames a second. Always 30. |

## `media`

Every file the video uses, under a key the other fields refer to.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `media.<key>.file` | file name | required | The file, in the assets folder beside edit.json: "assets/clip.mp4". The name may not start with "." (no hidden file, not the folder, not its parent). |
| `media.<key>.kind` | one of "video", "image", "audio" | required | What the file is. A shot takes a video or an image, a card an image, the music and a sound an audio file. |

## `styles`

Text styles of your own. A key that is a preset name (hook, label, tag, caption) replaces that preset; a text in it then comes and goes like a style of your own (fade 6 in and out, no stagger), not like the preset.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `styles.<name>.font` | one of "Inter", "Montserrat" | required | The typeface. Both cover Latin, Latin-1 and Latin Extended-A, nothing else. |
| `styles.<name>.weight` | number | required | How bold, 100 … 900. |
| `styles.<name>.size` | number | required | The size in px on this canvas, a whole number 8 … 400. A text that does not fit is shrunk down to "shrink" × this size. |
| `styles.<name>.align` | one of "left", "center", "right" | required | How the lines sit in the box, left to right. |
| `styles.<name>.fill` | colour | required | The colour of the letters. |
| `styles.<name>.shadows` | list of shadow (at most 8) | required | Shadow layers, each "<x>px <y>px <blur>px <colour>": "0px 4px 14px #00000080". An empty list for none. |
| `styles.<name>.upper` | true or false | false | true: the copy is shown in capitals. |
| `styles.<name>.tracking` | number | 0 | Space between letters in em, −0.05 … 0.3. |
| `styles.<name>.leading` | number | 1.15 | The height of a line as a multiple of the size, 1 … 2. |
| `styles.<name>.outline` | object | none | A line around every letter: what keeps a text readable on bright footage. |
| `styles.<name>.outline.width` | number | required | Its width in em of the size, 0.02 … 0.12. |
| `styles.<name>.outline.colour` | colour | required | Its colour, far from the fill. |
| `styles.<name>.plate` | object | none | A filled shape behind each line. |
| `styles.<name>.plate.colour` | colour | required | Its colour. |
| `styles.<name>.plate.radius` | number | required | How round its corners are, in em, 0 … 1. |
| `styles.<name>.plate.padX` | number | required | Room left and right of the line, in em, 0 … 1. |
| `styles.<name>.plate.padY` | number | required | Room above and below the line, in em, 0 … 1. |

## `shots`

The pictures of the video, in time order. They tile it: each starts on the frame the one before it ends.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shots[].id` | name | required | Its name. Unique among shots, texts, cards and sounds. |
| `shots[].at` | whole number ≥ 0 | required | Its first frame: 0 for the first shot, otherwise "at" + "for" of the shot before. |
| `shots[].for` | whole number ≥ 1 | required | How many frames it owns, at most 450. |
| `shots[].media` | name | required | The key of the video or image it shows. A picture that is larger than the canvas is cropped around "focus". |
| `shots[].from` | whole number ≥ 0 | 0 | The frame of the clip it starts on. The clip needs "from" + "for" frames, and more when the next shot comes in over it. |
| `shots[].focus` | [number 0 … 100, number 0 … 100] | [50, 50] | The point of the picture a crop keeps and a motion zooms on, as [x, y] in percent of the picture. |
| `shots[].motion` | Motion | none | A zoom on this shot. |
| `shots[].in` | Transition | { "kind": "cut" } | How this shot replaces the one before. Not allowed on the first shot. |
| `shots[].sound` | object | none | Plays the clip's own sound. Left out, the clip is silent. |
| `shots[].sound.gain` | number | required | Its volume, 0 … 2 (1 leaves it as it is). |
| `shots[].windows` | list of objects (at most 8) | none | Periods in which this shot shrinks into a small window in a corner while another picture fills the frame: a talker over a before / after picture. In ascending order, all in the same place. |
| `shots[].windows[].at` | whole number ≥ 0 | required | The frame on which the shot starts to shrink. A frame of the whole video, inside the shot. |
| `shots[].windows[].for` | whole number ≥ 1 | required | How long the window lasts, the shrink and the return included: at least 2 × "frames" + 1. |
| `shots[].windows[].corner` | one of "top-left", "top-right", "bottom-left", "bottom-right" | required | The corner of the safe area the window rests in. |
| `shots[].windows[].width` | number 20 … 60 | 38 | The width of the window in percent of the canvas; its height follows the canvas. At most 50 under the default safe area (both, reels), 60 under tiktok and none: a window is as high as it is wide and must fit the height of the safe area; a wider one is refused with window-range. |
| `shots[].windows[].radius` | number 0 … 8 | 2.6 | How round its corners are, in percent of the canvas width. |
| `shots[].windows[].frames` | whole number ≥ 1 | 10 | How many frames the shrink takes, and the return. |
| `shots[].windows[].behind` | name | required | The key of the picture (image or video) that fills the frame meanwhile. |
| `shots[].windows[].swaps` | list of objects (at most 8) | none | Changes of the picture behind, by a cut, while the window rests: a before, then an after. In ascending order. |
| `shots[].windows[].swaps[].at` | whole number ≥ 0 | required | The frame of the change: after the shrink, before the return. |
| `shots[].windows[].swaps[].behind` | name | required | The key of the picture shown from that frame. |
| `shots[].windows[].behindMotion` | Motion | none | A slow zoom on the picture behind ("push-in" or "pull-out"). |

## `texts`

Lines of text over the picture: hooks, labels, tags.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `texts[].id` | name | required | Its name. Unique among shots, texts, cards and sounds. |
| `texts[].at` | whole number ≥ 0 | required | The first frame it is on screen (its enter starts here). |
| `texts[].for` | whole number ≥ 1 | required | How many frames it is on screen, enter and exit included. It needs at least one frame between them. |
| `texts[].box` | Box | required | Where it may stand. The copy is laid out inside, and shrunk until it fits. |
| `texts[].style` | style name | required | A preset (hook, label, tag, caption) or a key of "styles". |
| `texts[].copy` | text (≤ 200 characters) | required | The words. "\n" forces a line break. Latin letters only. |
| `texts[].lines` | whole number 1 … 4 | the lines of the copy when it has "\n", else 2 | The most lines it may take. |
| `texts[].shrink` | number 0.5 … 1 | 0.6 | The smallest size it may be shrunk to, as a share of the style's size. A copy that still does not fit is the error text-too-long. |
| `texts[].valign` | one of "top", "middle", "bottom" | "middle" | Where the lines sit in the box, top to bottom. |
| `texts[].enter` | Enter | the style's (see Text styles); "fade" 6 for a style of your own | How it appears. |
| `texts[].exit` | Exit | the style's; "fade" 6 for a style of your own | How it leaves. |
| `texts[].stagger` | whole number 0 … 6 | the style's (2 for hook, else 0) | Frames between the enter of one line and the next. |
| `texts[].safe` | false | none | false: it may leave the safe area. |

## `captions`

The spoken words shown word by word, in groups, with the word being spoken marked.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `captions.box` | Box | required | Where the groups stand. One line of the style must fit its height, and the longest word its width. |
| `captions.style` | style name | "caption" | The style of the words. |
| `captions.words` | list of objects (at most 600) | required | The words as they are spoken, in order, none overlapping the next. |
| `captions.words[].text` | word (≤ 60 characters) | required | One word, without spaces. Its punctuation stays on it; ".", "!" or "?" at its end closes the group. |
| `captions.words[].at` | whole number ≥ 0 | required | The frame on which the word is first spoken. |
| `captions.words[].for` | whole number ≥ 1 | required | How many frames it is spoken. |
| `captions.group` | object | none | How the words are gathered into the groups shown together. |
| `captions.group.words` | whole number 1 … 4 | 3 | The most words in a group. |
| `captions.group.lines` | one of 1, 2 | 2 | The most lines of a group. |
| `captions.group.hold` | whole number ≥ 0 | 12 | A group stays this many frames after its last word, unless the next group begins sooner. |
| `captions.group.pause` | whole number ≥ 1 | 15 | A gap of this many frames between two words starts a new group. |
| `captions.active` | one of the forms "none", "colour", "pill" | { "kind": "colour", "colour": "#ffe000", "scale": 1.06 } | How the word being spoken is marked. |
| `captions.active{none}` | { "kind": "none" } |  | The word being spoken is not marked. |
| `captions.active{colour}` | { "kind": "colour", colour, scale? } |  | The word takes a colour and grows a little. |
| `captions.active{colour}.colour` | colour | required | The colour of the word while it is spoken. |
| `captions.active{colour}.scale` | number 1 … 1.5 | 1.06 | How large the word is while it is spoken. |
| `captions.active{pill}` | { "kind": "pill", colour, text? } |  | A filled shape behind the word. |
| `captions.active{pill}.colour` | colour | required | The colour of the shape. |
| `captions.active{pill}.text` | colour | none | The colour of the word on the shape. Left out, the word keeps the fill of its style. |
| `captions.enter` | Enter | { "kind": "pop", "frames": 5, "from": 0.8 } | How each group appears. |
| `captions.safe` | false | none | false: the captions may leave the safe area. |

## `cards`

Pictures over the footage: a product photo, a screenshot.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cards[].id` | name | required | Its name. Unique among shots, texts, cards and sounds. |
| `cards[].at` | whole number ≥ 0 | required | The first frame it is on screen. |
| `cards[].for` | whole number ≥ 1 | required | How many frames it is on screen, enter and exit included. |
| `cards[].media` | name | required | The key of the image it shows. |
| `cards[].box` | Box | required | Where it stands. |
| `cards[].fit` | one of "contain", "cover" | "contain" | "contain": the whole picture, as large as the box allows, centred (a product photo is never cropped). "cover": the box is filled and the picture cropped. |
| `cards[].radius` | number 0 … 50 | 3.3 | How round its corners are, in percent of the canvas width. |
| `cards[].enter` | Enter | { "kind": "pop", "frames": 8 } | How it appears. |
| `cards[].exit` | Exit | { "kind": "pop", "frames": 8 } | How it leaves. |
| `cards[].motion` | Motion | none | A slow zoom on the picture ("push-in" or "pull-out"). |
| `cards[].safe` | false | none | false: it may leave the safe area (a picture over the whole frame has the box 0, 0, 100, 100). |

## `audio`

The music, sound effects and the loudness of the mix. The own sound of a clip is switched on at its shot ("sound").

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `audio.music` | object | none | One music file under the whole video. |
| `audio.music.media` | name | required | The key of the audio file. It must be at least as long as the video, unless "loop" is true. |
| `audio.music.gain` | number | required | Its volume, 0 … 2 (1 leaves it as it is). About 0.5 under a voice. |
| `audio.music.from` | whole number ≥ 0 | 0 | The frame of the file the music starts on. |
| `audio.music.loop` | true or false | false | true: the file is repeated until the video ends (it needs at least 30 frames). |
| `audio.music.fadeIn` | whole number ≥ 0 | 0 | Frames over which the music comes up at the start. |
| `audio.music.fadeOut` | whole number ≥ 0 | 12 | Frames over which the music goes down at the end. |
| `audio.music.duck` | object | none | Lowers the music while something else should be heard. |
| `audio.music.duck.to` | number | required | The volume of the music while it is ducked: from 0 to its own gain. |
| `audio.music.duck.ramp` | whole number ≥ 1 | 6 | Frames the music takes to go down and to come back. |
| `audio.music.duck.under` | "sound", or "captions", or list of objects (at most 600) | required | "sound": while a shot plays its own sound. "captions": while caption words are spoken. Or the periods themselves. |
| `audio.music.duck.under[].at` | whole number ≥ 0 | required | The first frame of a period. |
| `audio.music.duck.under[].for` | whole number ≥ 1 | required | How many frames it lasts. |
| `audio.sounds` | list of objects (at most 100) | none | Sound effects, each played once. |
| `audio.sounds[].id` | name | required | Its name. Unique among shots, texts, cards and sounds. |
| `audio.sounds[].media` | name | required | The key of the audio file. |
| `audio.sounds[].at` | whole number ≥ 0 | required | The frame on which it starts. |
| `audio.sounds[].for` | whole number ≥ 1 | to the end of the file | How many frames of it are played. |
| `audio.sounds[].from` | whole number ≥ 0 | 0 | The frame of the file it starts on. |
| `audio.sounds[].gain` | number | required | Its volume, 0 … 2 (1 leaves it as it is). |
| `audio.master` | object, or false | { "lufs": -14, "peak": -1 } | After the render one pass brings the whole mix to this loudness, by gain only. false leaves the mix as rendered. |
| `audio.master.lufs` | number | required | The loudness of the mix in LUFS, −40 … −5. −14 is what the platforms play at. |
| `audio.master.peak` | number | -1 | The highest peak the pass may reach, in dBTP, −20 … 0. |

## `Box`

Where a text, the captions or a card may stand: four edges in percent of the canvas, each 0 … 100, left < right and top < bottom. { "left": 9, "top": 15, "right": 91, "bottom": 27 } is a band across the upper part.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Box.left` | number | required | The left edge, in percent of the canvas width. |
| `Box.top` | number | required | The top edge, in percent of the canvas height. |
| `Box.right` | number | required | The right edge, in percent of the canvas width. An edge, not a width. |
| `Box.bottom` | number | required | The bottom edge, in percent of the canvas height. An edge, not a height. |

## `Motion`

A slow or sudden zoom on a picture. The scale is 1 when the picture just fills its place. A card and the picture behind a window take "push-in" and "pull-out" only.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Motion{push-in}` | { "kind": "push-in", to?, ease? } |  | Grows slowly from 1 to "to" over the whole time on screen. |
| `Motion{push-in}.to` | number | 1.08 | The scale it ends at, 1.01 … 1.5. |
| `Motion{push-in}.ease` | one of "linear", "out", "in", "in-out", "back", "whip" | "linear" | The curve of the move (see Easings). |
| `Motion{pull-out}` | { "kind": "pull-out", from?, ease? } |  | Shrinks slowly from "from" to 1 over the whole time on screen. |
| `Motion{pull-out}.from` | number | 1.08 | The scale it starts at, 1.01 … 1.5. |
| `Motion{pull-out}.ease` | one of "linear", "out", "in", "in-out", "back", "whip" | "linear" | The curve of the move (see Easings). |
| `Motion{punch-in}` | { "kind": "punch-in", at, to?, frames? } |  | Jumps from 1 to "to" on a frame and stays there: an accent on a word or a beat. Shots only. |
| `Motion{punch-in}.at` | whole number ≥ 0 | required | The frame of the jump: a frame of the whole video, inside the shot. |
| `Motion{punch-in}.to` | number | 1.2 | The scale it jumps to, 1.01 … 1.5. |
| `Motion{punch-in}.frames` | whole number ≥ 1 | 4 | How many frames the jump takes. |

## `Transition`

How a shot replaces the one before it: written as "in" on the incoming shot. It never changes when the shot starts; "crossfade", "push" and "whip" show the outgoing clip for "frames" more frames, so that clip needs them.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Transition{cut}` | { "kind": "cut" } |  | The next picture on the next frame. What a shot without "in" has. |
| `Transition{crossfade}` | { "kind": "crossfade", frames? } |  | The incoming shot fades in over the outgoing one. |
| `Transition{crossfade}.frames` | whole number ≥ 1 | 8 | How many frames it takes; the outgoing clip needs that many more. |
| `Transition{push}` | { "kind": "push", to, frames? } |  | The incoming shot pushes the outgoing one off the canvas. |
| `Transition{push}.to` | one of "left", "right", "top", "bottom" | required | The side the pictures travel to. |
| `Transition{push}.frames` | whole number ≥ 1 | 10 | How many frames it takes; the outgoing clip needs that many more. |
| `Transition{whip}` | { "kind": "whip", to, frames? } |  | A push with motion blur: fast and loud. |
| `Transition{whip}.to` | one of "left", "right", "top", "bottom" | required | The side the pictures travel to. |
| `Transition{whip}.frames` | whole number ≥ 1 | 8 | How many frames it takes; the outgoing clip needs that many more. |
| `Transition{zoom}` | { "kind": "zoom", frames?, scale? } |  | The outgoing shot zooms in, the incoming one settles from a zoom. Half before the cut, half after; no extra frames of the clip. |
| `Transition{zoom}.frames` | whole number ≥ 1 | 8 | How many frames it takes, around the cut. |
| `Transition{zoom}.scale` | number | 1.3 | How far it zooms, 1.01 … 1.5. |
| `Transition{flash}` | { "kind": "flash", frames?, colour? } |  | A flash of colour over the cut. |
| `Transition{flash}.frames` | whole number ≥ 1 | 6 | How many frames it takes, around the cut. |
| `Transition{flash}.colour` | colour | "#ffffff" | The colour of the flash. |
| `Transition{dip}` | { "kind": "dip", frames?, colour? } |  | Down to a colour and back up: a pause between two parts. |
| `Transition{dip}.frames` | whole number ≥ 1 | 12 | How many frames it takes, around the cut. |
| `Transition{dip}.colour` | colour | "#000000" | The colour it dips to. |

## `Enter`

How a text, a card or a caption group appears, over its first frames.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Enter{none}` | { "kind": "none" } |  | It is there on its first frame. |
| `Enter{fade}` | { "kind": "fade", frames? } |  | It fades in. |
| `Enter{fade}.frames` | whole number ≥ 1 | 6 | How many frames it takes. |
| `Enter{pop}` | { "kind": "pop", frames?, from? } |  | It grows from small with a little overshoot. |
| `Enter{pop}.frames` | whole number ≥ 1 | 8 | How many frames it takes. |
| `Enter{pop}.from` | number 0 … 2 | 0.6 | The scale it starts at. |
| `Enter{slide}` | { "kind": "slide", from, frames?, distance? } |  | It slides in while it fades in. |
| `Enter{slide}.from` | one of "left", "right", "top", "bottom" | required | The side it comes from. |
| `Enter{slide}.frames` | whole number ≥ 1 | 8 | How many frames it takes. |
| `Enter{slide}.distance` | number 0 … 100 | 4 | How far it travels, in percent of the canvas height. |
| `Enter{blur}` | { "kind": "blur", frames?, radius? } |  | It comes into focus while it fades in. |
| `Enter{blur}.frames` | whole number ≥ 1 | 8 | How many frames it takes. |
| `Enter{blur}.radius` | number 0 … 10 | 2.2 | How blurred it starts, in percent of the canvas width. |

## `Exit`

How a text or a card leaves, over its last frames.

| Field | Type | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Exit{none}` | { "kind": "none" } |  | It is gone on the frame after its last one. |
| `Exit{fade}` | { "kind": "fade", frames? } |  | It fades out. |
| `Exit{fade}.frames` | whole number ≥ 1 | 6 | How many frames it takes. |
| `Exit{pop}` | { "kind": "pop", frames?, to? } |  | It shrinks while it fades out. |
| `Exit{pop}.frames` | whole number ≥ 1 | 8 | How many frames it takes. |
| `Exit{pop}.to` | number 0 … 2 | 0.8 | The scale it ends at. |
| `Exit{slide}` | { "kind": "slide", to, frames?, distance? } |  | It slides away while it fades out. |
| `Exit{slide}.to` | one of "left", "right", "top", "bottom" | required | The side it leaves to. |
| `Exit{slide}.frames` | whole number ≥ 1 | 8 | How many frames it takes. |
| `Exit{slide}.distance` | number 0 … 100 | 4 | How far it travels, in percent of the canvas height. |
| `Exit{blur}` | { "kind": "blur", frames?, radius? } |  | It goes out of focus while it fades out. |
| `Exit{blur}.frames` | whole number ≥ 1 | 8 | How many frames it takes. |
| `Exit{blur}.radius` | number 0 … 10 | 2.2 | How blurred it ends, in percent of the canvas width. |

## Text styles that exist without being listed

A text names one of these in "style", or a style of its own from "styles" (which may replace one of these by using its name). Sizes are px: the first on a canvas 1080 wide, the second on 720.

| Name | Font | Size | Fill | Outline | Plate | Other | Enter | Exit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hook` | Inter 800 | 72 / 48 | #ffffff | 0.08 em #000000 | none | leading 1.15, shadow 0px 4px 14px #00000080, center | pop 8 | fade 6 |
| `label` | Inter 600 | 44 / 29 | #ffffff | 0.07 em #000000 | none | center | fade 6 | fade 6 |
| `tag` | Inter 700 | 40 / 27 | #ffffff | none | #e0508c, radius 0.3 em, padding 0.5 / 0.22 em | center | pop 6 | fade 6 |
| `caption` | Montserrat 900 | 84 / 56 | #ffffff | 0.08 em #000000 | none | upper case, leading 1.28, center | pop 5 | none |

## Safe areas

In percent of the canvas. A text, the captions or a card must lie inside the area and outside the column of the platform's buttons, unless it says `"safe": false`.

| `safe` | Area | Column of the buttons |
|---|---|---|
| `both` | left 6, top 14, right 94, bottom 65 | left 86, top 45, right 100, bottom 65 |
| `reels` | left 6, top 14, right 94, bottom 65 | left 86, top 45, right 100, bottom 65 |
| `tiktok` | left 6, top 8, right 94, bottom 78 | left 86, top 45, right 100, bottom 78 |
| `none` | left 0, top 0, right 100, bottom 100 | none |

## Easings

| Name | Curve |
|---|---|
| `linear` | linear |
| `out` | cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) |
| `in` | cubic-bezier(0.7,0,0.84,0) |
| `in-out` | cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1) |
| `back` | cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) |
| `whip` | cubic-bezier(0.8,0,0.2,1) |

## Limits

| What | Limit |
|---|---|
| canvas | 720×1280 or 1080×1920, at 30 frames a second |
| the video | at most 60 s (1800 frames) |
| a shot | at most 15 s (450 frames) |
| a box | at least 16 × 16 px |
| the scale of a motion or a zoom | 1.01 … 1.5 |
| a gain | 0 … 2 |
| elements that carry a blur (whip transitions, blur enters and exits) | at most 24 |
| music that is looped | at least 30 frames long |
| entries of `media` | at most 300 |
| entries of `styles` | at most 50 |
| entries of `styles.<name>.shadows` | at most 8 |
| entries of `shots` | at most 120 |
| entries of `shots[].windows` | at most 8 |
| entries of `shots[].windows[].swaps` | at most 8 |
| entries of `texts` | at most 200 |
| entries of `captions.words` | at most 600 |
| entries of `cards` | at most 100 |
| entries of `audio.sounds` | at most 100 |
| entries of `audio.music.duck.under` | at most 600 |
